title: APEX Cross-Organ Evidence Envelope
description: Canonical constitutional envelope emitted by every organ (GEOX, WEALTH, WELL, AAA, A-FORGE, arifOS). Defines typed state vector X, three-layer verdict semantics, and the rule that a single high score cannot hide one fatal contradiction.
owner: APEX theory; ratified by arifOS constitutional runtime

schema_version.description: Lock-step binding. Any other value signals vendor fork.

organ.description: Source organ. Lowercase or unknown values are rejected at boundary.

claim_id.description: UUIDv4 — collision-free across federation. Aliyyah generates this; never reused.

claim_class.description: Epistemic rung per geox-claim-grammar v1.1+ / well-substrate-readiness.

evidence_level.description: Layer 0-6 memory architecture (L1 ephemeral → L6 VAULT999 sealed).

value.description: Cap at 0.95 unless APEX theory has been formally calibrated (F7 HUMILITY).

calibration_model.description: Identifier of the organ-specific calibration source. Each organ names its own model (e.g. 'geox-cal-v1', 'wealth-mc-1000', 'well-wavelet-freshness').

discipline.description: What the confidence number measures — required because cross-organ confidence=0.78 is not equivalent. Examples: 'probability_of_reservoir_presence', 'runway_survival_probability', 'human_readiness_adequacy_for_C4'.

observed_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp. The point at which the evidence was measured, not when the envelope was emitted.

expires_at.description: Hard expiry. After this moment, freshness is automatically UNKNOWN regardless of source-stated validity.

transform_chain.description: Optional record of transforms applied (Vsh→Φ→Sw etc.).

assumptions.description: Bounded assumptions. If any is later falsified, the envelope enters contradiction stream.

contradictions.description: Active conflicts with peer envelopes. Empty does NOT mean none possible — only none resolved yet.

missing_evidence.description: Specific tests or measurements whose absence prevents stronger claim_class. Distinct from assumptions: this is what we'd need to upgrade the claim; assumptions are what we accepted to make it.

state_vector.description: Typed APEX variable model — replaces scalar single-score.

U.description: Residual uncertainty (1 − normalised credible interval width).

C.description: Consequence severity in expected loss units (organ-defined).

V.description: Substrate viability — HUMAN and MACHINE separately.

A.description: Authority validity (signed mandate in scope and in time).

W.description: Witness independence (geometric mean of independent channels).

D.description: Dignity and rights status (constraint, not utility).

O.description: Remaining optionality — feasible future actions after this commitment.

verdict_layers.description: Three-layer decision structure: hard gates → robustness → preference. ANY gate failure dominates the score.

layer1_gates.description: Hard gates — any 0 fails. Returns VOID.

authority.description: 0 → VOID (no signed actor or expired mandate).

layer2_robustness.description: Robustness across alternative models, parameter ranges, adversarial cases, stakeholder perspectives, delayed consequences, common-mode failures. Any failure → HOLD.

layer3_preference.description: After admissible set is established, human preference selects among Pareto-optimal options. Sovereignty is preserved.

recommended_verdict.description: Organ's RECOMMENDED verdict. arifOS 888 is the only organ that ISSUES verdicts; everyone else recommends. SEALS are not auto-issued.

authority.description: Authority scope. Domain organs are REFLECT_ONLY/ADVISORY_ONLY/EVIDENCE_ONLY. No organ is SEAL-emitting except arifOS.

fast_path_annotation.description: Optional chain-ruling annotation for fast-path emissions (matching AGENTS.md known anomaly: pre-migration gap pattern is sovereign-ruled NON-ISSUE).

_documentation.principle: ONE high score cannot hide ONE fatal contradiction. Layer 1 gates dominate. Layer 2 HOLD/SEAL. Layer 3 PRESERVES sovereignty.

replaces_phrases.wavefunction_collapse: admissible-set reduction or posterior update (decision geometry, not quantum)
replaces_phrases.sovereign_entropy: behavioural-model dependence + profiling exposure + prediction confidence (auditable, not metaphysical)
replaces_phrases.thermodynamic_entropy_governance: policy drift + state divergence + coordination cost (governance metrics, not heat microstates)
replaces_phrases.human_readiness_score: vitality vector V_h with subsystem breakdown (multi-observation, never single scalar)
replaces_phrases.single_apex_score: three-layer verdict (gates + robustness + preference) — no single scalar

migration_path.phase_1: Per-organ envelopes continue to exist but MUST emit apex-envelope/1.0 outer wrapper at boundary.
migration_path.phase_2: Per-organ envelope shapes deprecate. Organ internal APIs may keep their native shape; cross-organ surfaces MUST conform to v1.0.
migration_path.phase_3: Phase 3 evaluation gate: every organ tested on v1.0 compliance; schema_version drift detection in operation.

consumers: arifOS 888 JUDGE — consumes verdict_layers to issue SEAL/HOLD/VOID
AAA cockpit — displays envelopes with provenance
A-FORGE — refuses to execute on envelopes with expired_at < now or verdict_layers.layer1_gates != 1
VAULT999 — seals envelopes as L6 records with schema_version pinned
